blocks.x: Were people still playing, were they selling the C melodies back then too?

I don’t know, they probably were because I saw some, but the C melody, the C melody, no that wasn’t — and then again, I really didn’t know either alto or tenor. Like I just wanted a saxophone you see? And then when I went to the theater and saw Lester Young and — no I didn’t see Lester Young but I mean I heard him on the records with Count Basie — well first of all, Jimmy Dorsey was my first inspiration, Jimmy Dorsey.
